body:
KubeClipper v1.6.0 was released on June 2, 2026 as a stable release. Release · Full changelog.
Included changes containerd 2 and Calico v3.31.5 support, with an updated Kubernetes matrix. Improved Operation commands and logs, including a cluster-wide TUI. kcctl set cluster for external cluster access configuration. Persistent registry configuration and fixes that preserve existing containerd configuration when updating registry authentication. Component matrix Kubernetes containerd Calico v1.36.1 (default) 2.2.4 v3.31.5 v1.35.0 1.7.29 v3.29.6 v1.34.2 1.7.29 v3.29.6 Source: v1.6.0 README. Available resources also depend on the uploaded versions and architecture.
Architecture and default ports 1.6 consists of kc-server, kc-agent, kcctl, Console, and platform etcd. It distributes tasks using built-in or external NATS. This differs from the API-driven Operation v2 architecture in 1.7.
Purpose Default port Console HTTP 80 Server API HTTPS 8080 Resource service 8081 NATS client / cluster 9889 / 9890, TLS enabled by default Platform etcd client / peer / metrics 12379 / 12380 / 12381 SSH deployment 22 Restrict management access and check your actual deployment configuration. Sources: v1.6.0 deployment options.
Command differences from 1.7 1.6 uses kcctl operation terminate; 1.7 uses cancel. 1.6 does not provide kcctl status or kcctl doctor; inspect node services and logs instead. Use the 1.6 matrix, NATS configuration, and task model with 1.6 binaries.

body:
KubeClipper v1.6.0 于 2026 年 6 月 2 日正式发布。Release · 完整变更。
发布内容 containerd 2 和 Calico v3.31.5 支持，更新 Kubernetes 组件矩阵。 Operation 命令和日志查看改进，包括按集群打开 TUI。 kcctl set cluster 可配置集群外部访问。 镜像仓库配置持久化，以及更新 registry 认证时保留现有 containerd 配置等修复。 组件矩阵 Kubernetes containerd Calico v1.36.1（默认） 2.2.4 v3.31.5 v1.35.0 1.7.29 v3.29.6 v1.34.2 1.7.29 v3.29.6 来源：v1.6.0 README。可用资源还取决于平台中已上传的版本和架构。
架构与默认端口 1.6 由 kc-server、kc-agent、kcctl、Console 及平台 etcd 组成，使用内置或外部 NATS 分发任务。它与 1.7 的 API 驱动 Operation v2 架构不同。
用途 默认端口 Console HTTP 80 Server API HTTPS 8080 资源服务 8081 NATS 客户端 / 集群 9889 / 9890，默认启用 TLS 平台 etcd client / peer / metrics 12379 / 12380 / 12381 SSH 部署 22 限制管理端口访问，并按部署配置核对实际端口。默认值来源：v1.6.0 部署选项。
与 1.7 的命令差异 1.6 终止操作使用 kcctl operation terminate；1.7 使用 cancel。 1.6 不提供 1.7 的 kcctl status、kcctl doctor，使用节点服务和日志排查。 1.6 文档中的组件矩阵、NATS 配置和任务模型应与 1.6 二进制配套使用。

title: Documentation

body:
1.6 Operations use the older task model and NATS. List operations, then copy the actual ID to inspect details and logs:
kcctl operation list kcctl operation list -c demo OPERATION_ID='<actual operation ID>' kcctl operation describe "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation logs "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation logs "$OPERATION_ID" --follow kcctl operation logs "$OPERATION_ID" --summary Open the cluster-wide TUI in an interactive terminal:
kcctl operation logs --cluster demo Preserve failed-step and node logs and resolve the cause before retrying. 1.6 only retries operations in failed status:
kcctl operation retry "$OPERATION_ID" Use terminate for running operations, rather than the 1.7 cancel command:
kcctl operation terminate "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation describe "$OPERATION_ID" A termination request does not roll back node changes. Inspect task, cluster, and node state before cleanup. Source: v1.6.0 Operation CLI.

body:
1.6 的 Operation 通过旧版任务模型和 NATS 执行。查询当前操作，复制实际 ID 查看详情和日志：
kcctl operation list kcctl operation list -c demo OPERATION_ID='<实际操作 ID>' kcctl operation describe "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation logs "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation logs "$OPERATION_ID" --follow kcctl operation logs "$OPERATION_ID" --summary 在交互式终端中，按集群进入 TUI：
kcctl operation logs --cluster demo 保留失败节点和步骤的日志，处理原因后再重试。1.6 的 retry 只接受 failed 状态：
kcctl operation retry "$OPERATION_ID" 终止 running 状态的操作使用 terminate，不是 1.7 的 cancel：
kcctl operation terminate "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation describe "$OPERATION_ID" 终止请求不代表节点变更已回滚。检查任务、集群和实际节点状态后再清理。命令来源：v1.6.0 Operation CLI。

title: 文档

body:
Run this example in Bash on a Linux amd64 deployment machine, using v1.6.0 binaries and the full deployment package. Prepare Linux nodes with systemd, SSH access, sudo permissions, and synchronized clocks. Check Kubernetes kernel, cgroup, and disk requirements.
Install the client The old installer at the 1.6 tag uses oss.kubeclipper.io, whose certificate has expired. Download directly from GitHub Release while keeping certificate verification enabled.
curl -fL -o kc-linux-amd64-v1.6.0.tar.gz \ https://github.com/kubeclipper/kubeclipper/releases/download/v1.6.0/kc-linux-amd64.tar.gz mkdir -p kc-client-v1.6.0 tar -xzf kc-linux-amd64-v1.6.0.tar.gz -C kc-client-v1.6.0 sudo install -m 0755 kc-client-v1.6.0/kcctl /usr/local/bin/kcctl kcctl version Select other client architectures from the 1.6 Release. arm64 archives contain an architecture subdirectory; inspect paths with tar -tzf before installing.
Download the full package and deploy The client archive is not the deployment package. Use the native OSS endpoint below. Full packages are available for amd64 and arm64.
curl -fL -o kc-amd64-v1.6.0.tar.gz \ https://kubeclipper.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/release/v1.6.0/kc-amd64.tar.gz read -r -s -p 'Set admin password: ' KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD printf '\n' kcctl deploy --user root --pk-file "$HOME/.ssh/id_rsa" \ --pkg "$PWD/kc-amd64-v1.6.0.tar.gz" \ --initial-password "$KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD" unset KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD Use an SSH private key that can access the nodes. The password must contain 8–16 characters, including uppercase and lowercase letters and digits. Consult kcctl deploy -h for multi-node options. Keep API and NATS TLS enabled.
Log in and create a cluster Replace Server and node addresses. Login prompts for the admin password. The Console uses http://SERVER_IP; the CLI uses the HTTPS API.
SERVER_IP=192.168.10.10 kcctl login --host "https://${SERVER_IP}:8080" --username admin kcctl get node kcctl resource list Confirm resource versions and architecture before creating a single-node lab cluster:
NODE=192.168.10.10 kcctl create cluster --name demo --master "$NODE" --untaint-master \ --k8s-version v1.36.1 --cri containerd --cri-version 2.2.4 \ --cni calico --cni-version v3.31.5 kcctl operation list -c demo kcctl get cluster demo -o yaml Obtain kubeconfig from cluster details. Verify kubectl get nodes -o wide, kubectl get pods -A, and kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose'. See operations and logs for troubleshooting.

body:
Registry resources describe Kubernetes image sources or containerd pull settings. Registering a registry does not copy images into it. Offline component packages are prepared separately.
kcctl create registry --name internal --host registry.example.com:5000 --scheme http kcctl get registry kcctl create registry -h kcctl registry -h This example uses an HTTP registry on a management network. Configure HTTPS, CA trust, and authentication for production. 1.6 also persists node and SSH configuration for kcctl registry; check existing configuration before subsequent operations.
During cluster creation, --image-registry internal selects the Kubernetes image source, and --cri-registry internal configures containerd pulls. Populate images first and verify node connectivity, certificates, and authentication. Source: v1.6.0 Registry CLI.

body:
以下命令在 Linux amd64 部署机的 Bash 中执行，使用 v1.6.0 客户端和完整部署包。准备使用 systemd、SSH 可达且部署用户有 sudo 权限的 Linux 节点；配置时间同步，核对 Kubernetes 的内核、cgroup 和磁盘要求。
安装客户端 1.6 发布标签中的旧安装脚本使用 oss.kubeclipper.io，该域名当前证书已过期。下面直接从 GitHub Release 下载客户端，不关闭证书校验。
curl -fL -o kc-linux-amd64-v1.6.0.tar.gz \ https://github.com/kubeclipper/kubeclipper/releases/download/v1.6.0/kc-linux-amd64.tar.gz mkdir -p kc-client-v1.6.0 tar -xzf kc-linux-amd64-v1.6.0.tar.gz -C kc-client-v1.6.0 sudo install -m 0755 kc-client-v1.6.0/kcctl /usr/local/bin/kcctl kcctl version 其他客户端架构从 1.6 Release选择对应包。arm64 归档中的二进制位于架构子目录，先用 tar -tzf 查看路径。
下载完整部署包并安装平台 客户端归档不能替代完整部署包。下面使用项目的 OSS 原生域名，amd64 和 arm64 均有对应完整部署包。
curl -fL -o kc-amd64-v1.6.0.tar.gz \ https://kubeclipper.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/release/v1.6.0/kc-amd64.tar.gz read -r -s -p '设置 admin 密码: ' KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD printf '\n' kcctl deploy --user root --pk-file "$HOME/.ssh/id_rsa" \ --pkg "$PWD/kc-amd64-v1.6.0.tar.gz" \ --initial-password "$KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD" unset KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD 使用可登录目标节点的 SSH 私钥，密码设为 8–16 位并包含大写、小写字母和数字。多节点部署参数通过 kcctl deploy -h 核对。保持 API 与 NATS 的 TLS 配置开启。
登录与创建集群 将 Server 地址和节点 IP 替换为自己的值，命令会提示输入 admin 密码。控制台入口为 http://SERVER_IP，CLI 使用 HTTPS API。
SERVER_IP=192.168.10.10 kcctl login --host "https://${SERVER_IP}:8080" --username admin kcctl get node kcctl resource list 先确认平台资源列表包含所需版本及节点架构，再创建单节点实验集群：
NODE=192.168.10.10 kcctl create cluster --name demo --master "$NODE" --untaint-master \ --k8s-version v1.36.1 --cri containerd --cri-version 2.2.4 \ --cni calico --cni-version v3.31.5 kcctl operation list -c demo kcctl get cluster demo -o yaml 安装完成后，从集群详情获取 kubeconfig，检查 kubectl get nodes -o wide、kubectl get pods -A 和 kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose'。操作排查见操作与日志。

title: 快速开始

body:
1.6 does not include the 1.7 kcctl status and kcctl doctor commands. Start with versions, API access, node services, and operation logs.
kcctl version kcctl get node kcctl get cluster kcctl operation list kcctl resource list Inspect services according to each Linux node’s role. Diagnose NATS, platform etcd, and Server failures separately.
sudo systemctl status kc-server kc-agent kc-etcd kc-nats --no-pager sudo journalctl -u kc-server -n 100 --no-pager sudo journalctl -u kc-agent -n 100 --no-pager sudo journalctl -u kc-nats -n 100 --no-pager Agent nodes may not run Server, etcd, or NATS. External NATS deployments have no local kc-nats service. Check actual roles and deployment configuration.
Before upgrading to 1.7 Back up platform etcd, configuration, certificates, authentication keys, and managed-cluster data. Rehearse the upgrade in a recoverable test environment, checking the NATS to Operation v2 transition, active tasks, and old operation records. Consult the 1.7 upgrade checklist and verify versions running across all components.
This page does not guarantee an in-place upgrade for every 1.6 deployment. Preserve errors and follow the recovery steps you rehearsed.

body:
1.6 不包含 1.7 的 kcctl status 和 kcctl doctor。从版本、API、节点服务和任务日志开始排查。
kcctl version kcctl get node kcctl get cluster kcctl operation list kcctl resource list 在 Linux 节点按实际角色检查 systemd 服务，保留错误日志。NATS、平台 etcd 和 Server 的故障需要分别定位。
sudo systemctl status kc-server kc-agent kc-etcd kc-nats --no-pager sudo journalctl -u kc-server -n 100 --no-pager sudo journalctl -u kc-agent -n 100 --no-pager sudo journalctl -u kc-nats -n 100 --no-pager Agent 节点不一定部署 Server、etcd 或 NATS，使用外部 NATS 时也不会有本地 kc-nats 服务。核对实际角色及部署配置。
升级到 1.7 前 备份平台 etcd、配置、证书、认证密钥及受管集群数据。在可恢复的测试环境验证升级路径，重点核对 NATS 到 Operation v2 的差异、运行中任务及旧操作记录。查看1.7 升级检查，并确认实际运行的全部组件版本。
本页不承诺所有 1.6 部署都可直接原地升级。失败时先保留日志并按演练过的恢复步骤处理。
